message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Windows Build

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - 'main'
    tags:
      - 'v/*'

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.ref_name != 'main' }}

jobs:
  windows_msi:
    name: Windows MSI
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        platform: [x64, ARM64]
    runs-on: nscloud-windows-2022-amd64-8x16
    environment: ${{ (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v/') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && 'release' || '' }}
    env:
      SIGN: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS != '' }}
    steps:
      - name: git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          package_json_file: obscura-ui/package.json

      - name: Install Pre-Requisites
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          choco install just nasm -y --no-progress
          Add-Content $env:GITHUB_PATH "$env:ProgramFiles\NASM"

      - name: Setup Rust
        # cargo runs in rustlib/, where rust-toolchain.toml pins the toolchain (the runner's
        # preinstalled stable is never used). Install the pinned toolchain and the Windows
        # targets into it explicitly.
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: rustlib
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-msvc aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Download wintun
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $zip = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'wintun-0.14.1.zip'
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://www.wintun.net/builds/wintun-0.14.1.zip' -OutFile $zip
          $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($hash -ne '07c256185d6ee3652e09fa55c0b673e2624b565e02c4b9091c79ca7d2f24ef51') {
            throw "wintun-0.14.1.zip SHA256 mismatch: got $hash"
          }
          Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath windows
          Rename-Item -Path windows/wintun -NewName wintun-0.14.1

      - name: Setup SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE from base64 secret data
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE: D:\Certificate_pkcs12.p12
        run: |
          $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String("${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE_B64 }}")
          [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($env:SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE, $bytes)

      - name: Setup DigiCert signing tools
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        uses: digicert/code-signing-software-trust-action@v1

      - name: Set OBSCURA_VERSION from tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v/')
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          $version = $env:TAG_NAME -replace '^v/', 'v'
          Add-Content $env:GITHUB_ENV "OBSCURA_VERSION=$version"

      - name: Build MSI (Signed)
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM: 0
          # sign.ps1 signs via smctl during the build; smctl reads SM_* to authenticate to KeyLocker.
          SM_HOST: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_HOST }}
          SM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_API_KEY }}
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE: D:\Certificate_pkcs12.p12
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD }}
          KEYPAIR_ALIAS: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          dotnet build windows/wix-msi/wix-msi.wixproj `
            -c Release `
            -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }} `
            -p:SignOutput=${{ env.SIGN }} `
            -p:SignKeypairAlias=${{ env.SIGN == 'true' && vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS || '' }}

      - name: Verify signature
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $msi = Get-ChildItem windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US/Obscura_*_${{ matrix.platform }}.msi | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $msi) { throw "No MSI found under windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US" }
          $signtool = Get-ChildItem "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\Windows Kits\10\bin" -Recurse -Filter signtool.exe |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\x64\\' } | Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
          & $signtool.FullName verify /pa /v $msi.FullName

      - name: Upload MSI
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: Obscura-${{ matrix.platform }}-msi
          path: windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US/Obscura_*_${{ matrix.platform }}.msi
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  merge_msi:
    name: Merge MSI artifacts
    needs: windows_msi
    runs-on: [nix]
    steps:
      - name: Merge MSI artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact/merge@v7
        with:
          name: Obscura-msi
          pattern: Obscura-*-msi
          delete-merged: true
          retention-days: 30",
  "rationale": "The workflow defines a two-cell matrix (x64, ARM64) for the Windows MSI build with fail-fast explicitly set to false. The P-LIT-FAIL-FAST pattern (cancel remaining matrix jobs after failure) directly targets this setting. When one platform cell fails, the windows_msi job fails regardless, so the dependent merge_msi job will not run; cancelling the surviving cell saves runner time without changing the pass/fail outcome of the required check or removing coverage for successful runs. The change is minimal (one value), adds no new network access, secrets, or privileged actions, and preserves all build steps and required checks. Evidence: the P-LIT-FAIL-FAST literature pattern reports matrix cancellation saves remaining work, and the synthetic experiment examples (scenario_passed) demonstrate fail-fast: false -> true on an equivalent matrix workload.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-FAIL-FAST", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-b6e04fef7ef24997", "experiment:batch-scenario-three-run-4bb0552aeb09c242"]
}

    environment: ${{ (startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v/') || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && 'release' || '' }}
    env:
      SIGN: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS != '' }}
    steps:
      - name: git checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v7

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v5
        with:
          dotnet-version: '10.0.x'

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          package_json_file: obscura-ui/package.json

      - name: Install Pre-Requisites
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          choco install just nasm -y --no-progress
          Add-Content $env:GITHUB_PATH "$env:ProgramFiles\\NASM"

      - name: Setup Rust
        # cargo runs in rustlib/, where rust-toolchain.toml pins the toolchain (the runner's
        # preinstalled stable is never used). Install the pinned toolchain and the Windows
        # targets into it explicitly.
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: rustlib
        run: |
          rustup toolchain install
          rustup target add x86_64-pc-windows-msvc aarch64-pc-windows-msvc

      - name: Download wintun
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $zip = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'wintun-0.14.1.zip'
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://www.wintun.net/builds/wintun-0.14.1.zip' -OutFile $zip
          $hash = (Get-FileHash -Path $zip -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          if ($hash -ne '07c256185d6ee3652e09fa55c0b673e2624b565e02c4b9091c79ca7d2f24ef51') {
            throw "wintun-0.14.1.zip SHA256 mismatch: got $hash"
          }
          Expand-Archive -Path $zip -DestinationPath windows
          Rename-Item -Path windows/wintun -NewName wintun-0.14.1

      - name: Setup SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE from base64 secret data
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE: D:\Certificate_pkcs12.p12
        run: |
          $bytes = [System.Convert]::FromBase64String("${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE_B64 }}")
          [System.IO.File]::WriteAllBytes($env:SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE, $bytes)

      - name: Setup DigiCert signing tools
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        uses: digicert/code-signing-software-trust-action@v1

      - name: Set OBSCURA_VERSION from tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v/')
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          $version = $env:TAG_NAME -replace '^v/', 'v'
          Add-Content $env:GITHUB_ENV "OBSCURA_VERSION=$version"

      - name: Build MSI (Signed)
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM: 0
          # sign.ps1 signs via smctl during the build; smctl reads SM_* to authenticate to KeyLocker.
          SM_HOST: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_HOST }}
          SM_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_API_KEY }}
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_FILE: D:\Certificate_pkcs12.p12
          SM_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.DIGICERT_SM_CLIENT_CERT_PASSWORD }}
          KEYPAIR_ALIAS: ${{ vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS }}
        run: |
          dotnet build windows/wix-msi/wix-msi.wixproj `
            -c Release `
            -p:Platform=${{ matrix.platform }} `
            -p:SignOutput=${{ env.SIGN }} `
            -p:SignKeypairAlias=${{ env.SIGN == 'true' && vars.DIGICERT_SM_KEYPAIR_ALIAS || '' }}

      - name: Verify signature
        if: env.SIGN == 'true'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $msi = Get-ChildItem windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US/Obscura_*_${{ matrix.platform }}.msi | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $msi) { throw "No MSI found under windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US" }
          $signtool = Get-ChildItem "${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}\\Windows Kits\\10\\bin" -Recurse -Filter signtool.exe |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -match '\\\\x64\\\\' } | Sort-Object FullName -Descending | Select-Object -First 1
          & $signtool.FullName verify /pa /v $msi.FullName

      - name: Upload MSI
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: Obscura-${{ matrix.platform }}-msi
          path: windows/wix-msi/bin/${{ matrix.platform }}/Release/en-US/Obscura_*_${{ matrix.platform }}.msi
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  merge_msi:
    name: Merge MSI artifacts
    needs: windows_msi
    runs-on: [nix]
    steps:
      - name: Merge MSI artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact/merge@v7
        with:
          name: Obscura-msi
          pattern: Obscura-*-msi
          delete-merged: true
          retention-days: 30
